supabase/functions/send-system-context/d.text: 360-day Rent Plans (\`pricing_version = v360\`) use a separate cycle waterfall and only while \`v360_settings.new_plans_enabled\` is on for plans created after that. The switch stays off until CFO, COO or super admin turn it on. Legacy and non-v360 plans use the 8% commission above (6% sub-agent + 2% parent; 10% before 2026-11-04). On a v360 cycle the tenant agent commission is 8% of Gross (6% sub-agent + 2% general). Cover Pool, Proxy Agent fee and tithe have their own ledger categories in the unapplied proposal \`docs/pending-migrations/20261102160100_v360_ledger_categories_and_partner_onboarding.sql\`. Worked example, rent UGX 100,000: Gross 142,772, Daily 4,760, collected 142,800; sub-agent 8,566, general agent 2,855, rail 3,500, landlord 100,000, partner margin 15,000, Cover Pool 2,885 (cycle 1: proxy 2,000 and pool 885), Welile 7% 9,994 (tithe 999, Welile keeps 8,995). A 360-day plan sets aside 15% for Partner Returns; each partner earns their own Returns rate (new partners: the current new-partner rate), not guaranteed. The pure function is \`v360CycleWaterfall\` in \`src/lib/contractEngine360.ts\`.
